name: The Wolf Beyond the Table
source:
After months away, you return to a familiar tabletop group and step back into an unfinished campaign. But the story waiting for you is not only about forests, rivers, old folklore, and a mysterious captain guarding a stolen page.

It is also about the empty chair you left behind.

[From [url=https://joeychubbyfox.itch.io/the-wolf-beyond-the-table]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
几个月后，你回到了熟悉的桌面组，并回到了未完成的战役中。但等待你的故事不仅仅是关于森林、河流、古老的民间传说和一位神秘的船长守卫被盗的书页。

这也与你留下的空椅子有关。

[来自[url=https://joeychubbyfox.itch.io/the-wolf-beyond-the-table]Itch.io[/url]]
